# CANDIDATE: VIX_FILTERED_GAP_FADE

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Large gaps at open tend to fade when VIX is low, providing a mean-reverting short-term edge opposite the gap direction. This edge exists because in low volatility environments (VIX < 15), gaps are often driven by temporary order imbalances or news that gets quickly arbitraged, leading to a reversion to the prior day's close.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: If gap size (open - prior close) / prior close > 0.005 (0.5%) and VIX < 15, then wait for the first 5-minute bar after open; if gap up, enter short when price moves below the open of that 5-minute bar; if gap down, enter long when price moves above the open of that 5-minute bar; enter at the close of the bar that triggers the condition. Exit shape: Stop = opposite side of the opening range (gap up: stop above OR high; gap down: stop below OR low); target = 1R or re-test of prior day's close; allow runner to trail with chandelier exit if price continues beyond target. Regime hint: Effective in low-volatility mornings (VIX < 15) and during the first 60 minutes; avoid when VIX > 20 or during high-impact news that can sustain gaps.
